name: gigasheet
description: Query large datasets in Gigasheet from Claude using natural language.
long_description: Connects Claude to spreadsheets you already have in Gigasheet. Filter, group, aggregate, and sort datasets far larger than Claude could read directly, and get just the matching rows back. Read-only: it queries existing sheets and never modifies them.

api_token.title: API token (optional)
api_token.description: Leave blank. Sign in with your Gigasheet account instead — Claude will walk you through it on your first query. Only fill this in if you have been given a service token to use.

endpoint.title: API endpoint
endpoint.description: Only change this if you are on a dedicated or self-hosted Gigasheet instance.

timeout.title: Query timeout (seconds)
timeout.description: How long to wait for a query before giving up. Raise this if you routinely query very large sheets.

tools.name: Analyze
tools.description: Filter, group, aggregate, and sort a Gigasheet dataset, returning the matching rows.

tools.name: gigasheet_login
tools.description: Sign in to Gigasheet with your own account.

tools.name: gigasheet_logout
tools.description: Sign out and erase stored credentials from this computer.
